1.name: Plague

effects.text: End of Round: Destroy any 2 persons in your kingdom. Then {flip}.

1.text: {passive} Stays in play. {triggeredForced} End of Round: Destroy any 2 persons in your kingdom. Then {flip}.
1.helpText: End of Round effects may affect any card in your kingdom. Normally, effects only affect cards in play unless stated otherwise, but since it is in the end of the round, all cards are in the discard pile and thus, all cards may be targeted for this effect.

4.name: Enemy Soldier

effects.text: When played, blocks 1 building / land in play.
End of Round: Destroy the blocked card, if any.

4.text: {triggeredForced} When played, blocks 1 building / land in play. {passive} Stays in play. {triggeredForced} End of Round: Destroy the blocked card, if any. {activated} Spend {sword}{sword} to defeat ({destroy}).
4.helpText:
When this card is played, it blocks 1 land (green banner) or 1 building (grey banner). It then stays in play with the blocked card until the end of round. If - by then - you haven't been able to defeat him by spending 2 swords [sword], he destroys the blocked card.
If this card is played and there are no lands or buildings in play, the effect "misses" and the card simply doesn't block any card. It still stays in play, but its end of round effect will be ignored.

description: The Plague, once played, stays in play until the end of the round, where it kills 2 of your persons (yellow banners). If you have cards that discard cards from the top of your deck, you might be able to postpone this effect a round or two, but it will happen eventually.
